changelog:
v6.9 — Boot-scan notifications no longer show any time at all (no static posting time, no live timer) on both the progress and result notifications.
v6.8 — Boot-scan result notification now shows a live running timer (chronometer counting up in real time since the result was posted) instead of the static posting time.
v6.7 — Fixed incomplete language switching: after tapping the ID/EN button some texts stayed in the previous language (most visibly the "CHECK RESULTS" list header, which had no view ID and was never refreshed, and any string resolved through the Activity after a switch). The Activity's resources now always follow the active language and every visible text — list header, verdict, counts, scan time, check titles, bootloader card, disclaimer and footer — is rewritten instantly on toggle, including the pre-scan default verdict while a scan is still running.
v6.6 — Stability & speed release (full code audit). Fixed a force close a few seconds after launch: the OTA update dialog could be shown after the activity was already closed (BadTokenException) — now guarded. Scan is dramatically faster: all 19 checks now run in parallel, the su probe runs once per scan (no double su -c id, no double root prompt), shell output is drained concurrently (fixed a pipe deadlock that burned full timeouts), and shell timeouts were tightened. Faster startup: scan sounds now prepare in the background instead of blocking the main thread, MediaPlayers are properly released, and the signature self-check caches its positive result. Boot scan fixes: the result notification no longer shares the foreground-service notification ID (it could be wiped by stopForeground), per-result notification sounds now use two dedicated channels (channel sounds are immutable once created), duplicate concurrent boot scans are prevented, failed OTA downloads no longer leave ghost files in Downloads, the boot log is size-capped, and the dex is now built for the declared minSdk 21 (lambda desugaring) so older devices can't crash on un-desugared bytecode.
v6.5 — Test release to verify the new built-in OTA downloader (own progress notification 0–100%, APK saved straight to the Download folder).
v6.4 — Fixed invisible OTA download: replaced the system DownloadManager with a built-in downloader that shows its own progress notification (0–100%) and saves the APK straight to the public Download folder.
v6.3 — Official English release notes published.
v6.2 — Fixed OTA update check URL to the correct public repository (droidforgeindo/DFDetector).
v6.1 — New: one-tap OTA updates via GitHub (automatic check max once per 24h, download via DownloadManager, tap-to-install notification).
v6.0 — Fixed force close when opening the About dialog (it was built with a locale-wrapped context lacking the Activity window token). Scan sounds switched from SoundPool to MediaPlayer for guaranteed playback.
v5.9 — Scan result sounds now play instantly with zero delay (preloaded at startup).
v5.8 — Removed the /data/adb module-directory check; added a "Test sound" button in the About dialog.
v5.7 — Removed the experimental toolbar reboot button; toolbar restored to original.
v5.5 — New: audio alerts — pleasant chime when clean, warning alarm when root is detected (also used by the boot-scan notification).
v5.4 — About, check-detail, and bootloader dialogs now follow the language switch immediately.
v5.3 — su binary detection now probes absolute paths (/system/bin/su, /data/adb/ksu/bin/su, …), fixing SukiSU/KernelSU devices where su was not on PATH.
v5.2 — /data/adb check falls back to su -c ls /data/adb so rooted devices get a definitive result instead of UNKNOWN.
v5.1 — Language toggle is now instant (updates rows in place instead of rebuilding the list).
v5.0 — Removed the unstable boot overlay; boot auto-scan is now notification-only (heads-up + full-screen intent + ongoing notification). Fixed su process deadlock during boot scans.
